description: React component for the public layout of a developer analytics dashboard, including theme toggling, GitHub star count fetching, navigation, header, footer, and routing outlet.

methods.name: getInitialTheme
methods.description: Determines the initial theme ('light' or 'dark') based on local storage or user preferences.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Applies the selected theme to the document and stores it in local storage.

methods.name: formatCompactInt
methods.description: Formats a number into a compact string representation, e.g., '1.2K'.
